> **A note on contributions and the use of AI.** Our differing levels of
> familiarity with Git and GitHub resulted in uneven commit counts in the
> repository history; commit counts do not reflect effort, and all three
> team members contributed equally across data collection, preprocessing,
> exploratory analysis, machine learning, and the web application. We
> used AI-assisted tools to help with code writing, debugging, and
> polishing this report; every AI-generated output was reviewed and
> validated by the team, who take full responsibility for the final
> results. More details can be found in the project
